name: Thomas More University
tuition_note: Private university with a single tuition rate for all students. 2024-25 tuition & required fees ($39,800) and on-campus food & housing ($9,900) from NCES College Navigator/IPEDS (id 157809); tuition figure corroborated by collegetuitioncompare.com (2024-25 tuition & fees $39,025, room & board $9,900). Official thomasmore.edu cost page returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched directly. Housing figure is combined food & housing (room + board); room-only not separately published.
